dataSourceInstructions:
Following is a description of few tables:
dimcustomer: Captures detailed customer demographics and lifestyle attributes including name, contact details, education, occupation, household composition, and purchasing behavior.

dimdate: Provides calendar and fiscal time breakdowns to support time-based analysis, including day, month, quarter, and year attributes in multiple languages.

dimgeography: Enables location-based segmentation with city, state, country, and postal code details, supporting multilingual region names.

dimproduct: Provides extensive product metadata including multilingual descriptions, pricing, manufacturing details

dimproductcategory: Organizes products into hierarchical categories and subcategories with multilingual support.

dimsalesterritory: Maps sales regions and groups for territory-based performance tracking.

factinternetsales: Records detailed sales transactions including order details, pricing, discounts, and shipping information.

prospectivebuyer: Profiles potential customers with demographic and contact information for lead generation.
